# Code of conduct

party.js is a small project made for fun, and it should be fun to take part in. Everyone is welcome here, whatever their background, identity or experience.

## Expected behavior

- Be kind and patient, especially with people who are new to the project or to open source.
- Give and take feedback on the work, not the person.
- Assume good intent, and ask before you assume.

## Not tolerated

- Harassment, insults, or discriminatory jokes and language.
- Personal or political attacks.
- Publishing someone's private information without their permission.
- Any other behavior that would be unwelcome in a professional setting.

## Scope

This applies to the repository, its issues, pull requests and discussions, and to anyone representing the project elsewhere.

## Enforcement

If something here is broken, contact the maintainer at [yiliansource@gmail.com](mailto:yiliansource@gmail.com). Reports are handled confidentially. The maintainer may remove comments, lock threads, or ban people from the project, depending on how serious the behavior is.
